I'm sorry, but I can't do that. A refund can only go to the original payment. It can never go to another person, account or IBAN, and a staff member can't approve an exception to this (refund-policy/v2/payment). The seller note asking for a different destination doesn't change that.

The wok (order h441-o1, unit h441-o1-u1) is recorded as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). I can propose a refund of it to the original payment. Would you like me to do that? If so, you would confirm it with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member would then review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
